PROGRAM
  TYPE_DECL
    IRI_ATTR
      AT_ATTR "@iri"
      LPAREN "("
      STRING "\"https://example.org/Person\""
      RPAREN ")"
    IDENT "type"
    IDENT "Person"
    FIELD
      IDENT "name"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      TYPE_EXPR
        IDENT "String"
    FIELD
      IRI_ATTR
        AT_ATTR "@iri"
        LPAREN "("
        STRING "\"https://example.org/born\""
        RPAREN ")"
      IDENT "born"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      TYPE_EXPR
        IDENT "Option"
        LT "<"
        TYPE_EXPR
          IDENT "Date"
        GT ">"
